about:
PL&E Sales, Inc. traces its roots to April 1910 when John Purser, John London, and William Edwards founded Purser, London and Edwards in Charlotte, North Carolina. The firm adopted its current name in 1986 when shareholders shortened the corporate identity to avoid sounding like a law practice. Now based on Sam Roper Drive in Charlotte, the company operates as a manufacturer's representative across North and South Carolina.

The firm represents a portfolio of power-system manufacturers including ASCO Power Technologies, Cooper Power Systems, Federal Pacific, Gindre Copper, Bender, SENS, and TMC Transformers. Its core services encompass relay settings and commissioning, field sales engineering, project management, and inside technical support. A team of seven — led by CEO Billy Blackburn (with the company since 1996) and COO Rodney Mathis (since 2004) — manages more than 800 active customer accounts and logged 841 awarded projects in 2024.

Customers span the construction, industrial, electrical, and automation sectors, with notable work in water and wastewater treatment (such as the Manchester WWTP medium-voltage paralleling switchgear installation) and healthcare facilities through Bender's isolated power panels. The company serves consulting engineers, contractors, and end users who require local technical presence for critical power infrastructure.

PL&E Sales emphasizes technical depth and on-site responsiveness as its differentiators, positioning itself as a true field sales office for the manufacturers it represents. Leadership highlights succession planning to ensure continuity as the Carolinas' electrical grid evolves.
